messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Write 20 questions a person in India might ask a health-insurance help assistant, on the theme 'tax deductions and premiums', that are NOT answered by IRDAI's health-insurance circulars on product standards, waiting periods, moratorium, portability, cashless claims, grievances and standard definitions/exclusions. They should sound related to insurance so the assistant is tempted to answer. JSON: {"questions": [str]}

content:
{
  "questions": [
    "Can I claim a tax deduction under Section 80D if I pay my health insurance premium via a credit card?",
    "Is the premium paid for my employer-sponsored group health insurance eligible for tax deduction in my personal income tax return?",
    "What is the maximum amount I can claim as a tax deduction if I share a family floater policy with my parents?",
    "Does paying the health insurance premium in installments affect my eligibility for the full annual tax deduction?",
    "If I split my family floater premium between two bank accounts, can both household members claim separate deductions?",
    "Is the premium for a critical illness rider that is part of my health policy separately eligible for tax deduction?",
    "Can I claim a tax deduction for the premium of a health policy that is currently in its waiting period and active?",
    "Does the tax deduction limit increase if I choose a higher sum assured on my individual health plan?",
    "Is the premium paid for a health top-up policy eligible for tax deduction under the same limits as the base policy?",
    "If I pay for my mother’s health policy from my salary account, can I claim the tax deduction or must she claim it?",
    "Does changing the mode of premium payment from auto-debit to manual transfer impact my tax benefit claim?",
    "Can I claim a tax deduction if my health insurance policy is lapsed and I am currently paying the arrears to revive it?",
    "Is the premium for a health policy purchased through a corporate tie-up eligible for the full statutory tax deduction?",
    "Does the tax deduction apply to the entire premium including GST and other regulatory charges?",
    "If I buy a health policy for my child, can I claim the tax deduction or does it need to be claimed under their name?",
    "Can I claim a tax deduction for a health policy if the premium is funded by a loan against my property?",
    "Is the tax deduction limit different for my health insurance premium if I am a senior citizen?",
    "Does the tax benefit continue if I convert my health policy into a cashless claim settlement mode mid-policy year?",
    "Can I claim a tax deduction for the premium of a health policy that is purchased solely for preventive health check-ups?",
    "If I have two separate individual health policies, can I claim the tax deduction on both up to the maximum limit?"
  ]
}
